"Scaime S.A.S" is more complete/canonical. The document value "SCAIME" is just a truncated form (likely the name portion before address). Since the certificate is the legal instrument, but for same-entity cases with suffix drift, the more complete legal form is preferable. Register's "Scaime S.A.S" includes the legal suffix, making it the better canonical value.
